snippet.title: Reflection trailer
snippet.description:
Reflection is a  indie VR puzzle game with a traditional Chinese ring to it. Tracing back to the fifth chapter in Dream of the Red Chamber, the game draws inspiration from Jia Baoyu’s visit to The land of Faery, and advances to create a brand-new game using mirrors to solve puzzles. Players will enter the multi-dimensional space created by the mirror, and Experience the combination of “The Void” and “The Solid”, as well as the karmic wheel of cause and effect, birth and rebirth.

Reflection will be realsed on Steam in September, 2022.

Please visit our steam store page  to get more information. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1698020/_/
